art_direction: 倾斜螺旋星系拥有暖亮核心与蓝紫旋臂，暗尘带细节清楚，四周深空留白。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Depict one spiral galaxy tilted slightly from face-on, with a compact warm ivory core and two broad blue-violet arms. Use dark dust lanes to separate the arms and reveal their winding structure, while small embedded star clusters add detail near the core. Keep the galaxy centered and surrounded by substantial deep-black space so its silhouette remains clear. Avoid turning every star into a flare or making the colors oversaturated. The image should feel like a close astronomical portrait with layered dust and restrained luminosity. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
